scenario: [IRET.25.5.3]: no separator a component can contain. The keys ("a\u0001b", "c") and ("a", "b\u0001c") are two keys; a repeat of the first is suppressed by the 10s cooldown, the control. `by: e.a, e.b` makes the two slots the key, in that order ([LCDB.3.3.4]). PATH PINNED: libds `rk_walk` length-prefixes each string and Mercury `ds.rate.activation_key` keeps one part per value; a text key that joins fields with an unescaped 0x01 renders both `a\x01b\x01c` and suppresses the second.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope ttl 1_min:
    a: String
    b: String

rule r cooldown 10_s by: e.a, e.b:
    Ev e
->
    log info "fire"
